notes: Deny class is home-WIDE find ($HOME/**, /home/<user>/**, ~/**) except the named allow class, plus recursive grep on ~/.hermes *.db.
Home-wide means prefix, not exact home root. Subtrees (.ssh, .config, .local, Documents, Documents/Projects/bhd) DENY without unlock.
maxdepth / -name / -mmin / -newermt do NOT exempt a home prefix.
Allow class is cwd/repo scoped walks, known goal dirs, and maxdepth<=2 under <repo>/.worktrees.
.worktrees maxdepth is a real gate: maxdepth 99 DENY. Advertising maxdepth<=2 without a test is how Stage 2 shipped an unenforced exception.
Compound bash -c must classify the INNER find/grep, not only program=bash.
systemd wt-reap-idle does not pass the pi bash hook — opa-net alone will not stop it (OT-systemd).
Unlock is per-rule (LD-L1). No god-key (LD-L2). source must be opa-unlocked (LD-L6). Fail-open stays as policy default; deny-class must not take the timeout path (source !== fail-open).
